issues.title: On the first FFX-2 top list the first key only clears the coach bubble, and under the new default the gauges run during that press
issues.expected: The bubble says "Open a list"; the first Enter opens the highlighted list.
issues.observed: The first Enter (or Escape) dismisses the bubble and the list stays closed; a second Enter opens it. Identical on live (default and ?wait=split), so not a regression, but under the split the clock is now running while that key is spent.
issues.repro: Chapter 4 seed 5, first top list with the bubble up, press Enter once: level stays top (data/firstenter).
issues.confidence: high: measured on the candidate and live
issues.where: src/ui/coach/CoachLayer.ts (suspected: the bubble claims the first key)
issues.fix: Let the first confirm pass through to the menu while the non-blocking FFX-2 bubble is up, or leave as is and let Bailey decide.
issues.acceptanceCheck: Chapter 4 first top list: one Enter opens the highlighted list and the bubble goes.

issues.title: Escape and P do not open the pause during the Trigger Happy minigame
issues.expected: Escape/P/Start pause at every battle state.
issues.observed: With the Trigger Happy minigame up, Escape and P leave the screen on battle; identical on live.
issues.repro: Chapter 6 seed 3, Yuna: Skill > Trigger Happy > Enter, then Escape.
issues.where: suspected: the minigame widget takes the keyboard
issues.fix: Route Escape/P/Start to the pause from the minigame (pausing its timer), or confirm with Bailey that the minigame is exempt.
issues.acceptanceCheck: Escape during Trigger Happy opens the pause, the minigame timer freezes and resumes.

issues.title: The clock chip shows only while aiming: nothing says RUNNING at the top list or HELD in a submenu under the new default
issues.expected: The player can see when the clock runs and when it holds (the badge says it once, on the first turn only).
issues.observed: Top list: no chip (running). Submenu: no chip (held). Target cursor: "WAIT — ATB HELD". Carries DC2-04, now visible to every player because the split is the default.
issues.repro: Chapter 4, any turn after the first: open the top list, then a submenu, then aim.
issues.requirement: research/ffx2-combat-core.md 1.5 (the on-screen indicator flips between Active and Wait mode)
issues.fix: Options for Bailey (hard rule 9): the chip at all three levels, or only the retail Active/Wait mode indicator.
issues.acceptanceCheck: A picked option is visible at the top list, in a submenu and while aiming in chapters 4-6.

issues.title: The candidate tree's target records for tiles C1 and C3 still describe the superseded Wait drafts
issues.expected: docs/target/targets.json C1/C3 reaction names D-121 (Bailey adopted 1a, 2a, 3a on 2026-09-24).
issues.observed: The candidate's records still list the agent drafts ("clock holds while you choose", "Menu's up · gauges holding") as inferred and awaiting Bailey; main's decisions.json has D-121.
issues.fix: Record D-121 in the C1 tile reaction on main.
issues.acceptanceCheck: The C1 reaction cites D-121 and the three adopted lines.
